## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c3020ab1f3c6cceadd6dc0bcf93c8ebdb1593df8`
Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `node scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs` run once each in a detached read-only worktree at this head, so the ratchet reading in ③ is this seat's own; nothing built, nothing else run.

Read-only shape otherwise: the diff against the merge base 417443eb, card #21467 with every comment (the triage direction, the first dev report, the seat's amendment 5976088949), the owning copies of the two deleted lines on `origin/main`, and this head's check-runs. Reviewed by the dispatch seat in seat (served tier equals the constant's value, read from `get_session`). Review face: `.claude/skills/**`, harness-loaded protocol text (Tier S). Readings taken at 2026-10-04T04:04Z.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: unchanged. Protocol prose in one per-fire references file (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`, +2/−2); no gate, script, schema or runtime behaviour moves. `Clause-②: no` holds. ⛔ No new gate, as the direction required.
- The direction's two sentences, each read by this seat off the diff, both in 〈候选与批次〉: the fold line (after the fold-or-serial answer line) says a triage fold proposal is advisory, holds only while none of the named cards has an open PR, and otherwise each card lands on its own with the decline recorded in one line; the follow-up line (after the escalated-card line) says a follow-up a grade foresees is a card filed when its trigger lands, and ⛔ a triage line never authorises an edit without a card. Both are self-contained rules citing no card number (`check-skill-id-lint`: 34 files clean, this seat's own run).
- The payment, as the seat ruled on the card (5976088949): the two deleted lines are restatements whose owning copies stay on the reading path — the release line's twin is `references/state-machine.md` (the 释放者 row, same fields, same same-write rule) with the per-fire mention kept in `SKILL.md` 〈状态模型〉; the stall-gradient line's twin is `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈停摆复位梯度〉, which the stall path of the surrounding lines already sends the seat to. Neither line landed under a maintainer-ruled raise of this file (both arrived with the per-phase split that set its ceiling), so the ruled-clause precedent is untouched. The optional pointer on the SendMessage line was not added; that line stands as it was.
- Line reading: 183 → 183 (the seat's own count on the head blob); the branch carries a merge of `origin/main` (a merge commit, no rewrite) and the patch commit on top.

### ② Semver level

- No released package publishes from this diff (`.claude/**` ships nowhere); no changeset owed; `skip-changeset` is the correct declaration. No ADR-0087 disposition applies.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags: the first report's `open_questions[0]` (how to pay the ceiling) is answered by the seat's amendment and closed by this head; no second report exists: the dev subagent was terminated by the platform's usage wall after pushing the patch commit, so this seat reads the patch head directly under the direct-acceptance fallback (draft PR present, CI all green on the head, the subagent confirmed dead, the report not delivered) with no reduction of the review criteria. `out_of_scope_findings`: the two density observations are consumed by this very patch; the `spec-property-retirement` table-row pin hint is noted, not a card.
- Ratchet, this seat's own run at the head: every `.claude/skills/**` entry within its ceiling, `execution-duties.md` at 183 of 183 (headroom 0 as before); `check-skill-id-lint` clean.
- Deviation read: the first round's placement choice (both lines in one section, the direction's "the section" read as singular) and the 维护者速读 section kept per os-dev.md — recorded, no action; `mcp_calls` 0; `api_writes` 4 over 3 dispatches in the first round plus one `git push` for the patch, as the thread shows; the first report comment 5976067948 is present and parses.
- Check-runs on this head at this write: 17 success, 9 skipped, none in progress — the enqueue gate reads them at landing, not this record.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-21467-fold-proposal-and-uncarded-follow-up`
Reviewed-by: `session_01CB6W87z22K2yjUCDyVrJRk`

**VERDICT: PASS**
